en.explanation:
Here is added to , so the pH starts above 7 and falls as acid is added; curves (B) and (D), in which the pH rises, are excluded.

Before the equivalence point the solution contains and , a basic buffer, so the pH falls only gradually.

At the equivalence point only is present, and its cation hydrolyses (), so the equivalence point lies below pH 7 and the jump around it is small; afterwards excess keeps the pH low.

Curve (A), a gradual fall with a short drop centred below pH 7, matches. Curve (C), a long, almost vertical drop across pH 7, is the shape for a strong base titrated with a strong acid.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

hi.content: दुर्बल क्षार प्रबल अम्ल के लिए पीएच-मीट्रिक आरेख होगा :
hi.explanation:
यहाँ को में मिलाया जाता है, अतः pH प्रारम्भ में 7 से अधिक होता है और अम्ल मिलाने पर घटता है; वक्र (B) और (D), जिनमें pH बढ़ता है, अस्वीकृत हो जाते हैं।

तुल्यांक बिन्दु से पूर्व विलयन में और उपस्थित होते हैं, जो एक क्षारीय बफर है, अतः pH केवल धीरे-धीरे घटता है।

तुल्यांक बिन्दु पर केवल उपस्थित होता है, और इसका धनायन जलअपघटित होता है (), अतः तुल्यांक बिन्दु pH 7 से नीचे होता है और उसके आसपास का उछाल छोटा होता है; इसके बाद आधिक्य pH को निम्न बनाए रखता है।

वक्र (A), जिसमें pH 7 से नीचे केन्द्रित एक छोटे गिराव के साथ क्रमिक कमी है, मेल खाता है। वक्र (C), जिसमें pH 7 के आर-पार लम्बा, लगभग ऊर्ध्वाधर गिराव है, प्रबल क्षारक के प्रबल अम्ल से अनुमापन का आकार है।

अतः, सही विकल्प (A) है।

en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : For KI, molar conductivity increases steeply with dilution

Statement II : For carbonic acid, molar conductivity increases slowly with dilution

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true

en.explanation:
Statement I is false : KI is a strong electrolyte which gets completely dissociate on dissolution. On dilution, the molar conductivity almost remain constant.

Statement II is false : carbonic acid is a weak electrolyte which do not gets completely dissociate on dissolution. On dilution the molar conductivity of weak electrolyte increases sharply.



Both Statements are false.

en.content: An organic compound contains nitrogen and chlorine. It dissolves readily in water to give a solution that turns litmus red. Titration of compound with standard base indicates that the molecular weight of is . When a sample of is treated with aq. , a liquid separates which contains but not . Treatment of the obtained liquid with nitrous acid followed by phenol gives orange precipitate. The compound is :
en.explanation:
Compound A is acidic in water, contains N and Cl, and with aq. NaOH gives a liquid amine that contains N but not Cl, so A is the hydrochloride salt of an amine:

The liberated amine gives an orange azo dye with nitrous acid followed by phenol, so it is an aromatic primary amine: only an arenediazonium salt is stable enough to couple with phenol. The amine is aniline and A is anilinium chloride.

For , , which lies within .

In (A) and (C) the nitrogen is bonded to an sp³ carbon, so the freed amines are aliphatic primary amines whose diazonium salts lose and give no azo dye; (B) is a free chloroaniline, not a salt, and its liquid would contain Cl.

Hence, the correct option is (D).

hi.content: एक कार्बनिक यौगिक '' जिसमें नाइट्रोजन तथा क्लोरीन समावेशित हैं, जल में अति शीघ्र घुलकर एक विलयन देता है जो लिटमस को लाल कर देता है। यौगिक '' का मानक क्षार से अनुमापन इसकी आण्विक संहति सूचित करता है। को जलीय से उपचारित करने पर एक द्रव पृथक होता है जिसमें समावेशित होती है परन्तु नहीं। इस द्रव का उपचार नाइट्रस अम्ल तत्पश्चात फीनॉल से करने पर एक नारंगी अवक्षेप प्राप्त होता है। यौगिक है :
hi.explanation:
यौगिक A जल में अम्लीय है, इसमें N और Cl हैं, और जलीय NaOH के साथ एक द्रव ऐमीन देता है जिसमें N है पर Cl नहीं, अतः A किसी ऐमीन का हाइड्रोक्लोराइड लवण है:

मुक्त हुई ऐमीन नाइट्रस अम्ल और फिर फीनॉल के साथ नारंगी ऐज़ो रंजक देती है, अतः यह ऐरोमैटिक प्राथमिक ऐमीन है: केवल ऐरीनडाइऐज़ोनियम लवण ही फीनॉल के साथ युग्मन के लिए पर्याप्त स्थायी होता है। ऐमीन ऐनिलीन है और A ऐनिलिनियम क्लोराइड है।

के लिए, , जो के भीतर है।

(A) और (C) में नाइट्रोजन sp³ कार्बन से बँधी है, अतः मुक्त ऐमीनें ऐलिफैटिक प्राथमिक ऐमीनें हैं जिनके डाइऐज़ोनियम लवण त्याग देते हैं और ऐज़ो रंजक नहीं देते; (B) एक मुक्त क्लोरोऐनिलीन है, लवण नहीं, और इसके द्रव में Cl होता।

अतः, सही विकल्प (D) है।

en.content:
Match List - I with List - II.

List - I
(Mixture)		 List - II
(Purification Process)
(A) Chloroform & Aniline (I) Steam distillation
(B) Benzoic acid & Naphthalene (II) Sublimation
(C) Water & Aniline (III) Distillation
(D) Naphthalene & Sodium chloride (IV) Crystallisation

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
en.explanation:
(A) Chloroform (b.p. 334 K) and aniline (b.p. 457 K) are miscible liquids with widely different boiling points, so simple distillation separates them: (III).

(B) Benzoic acid and naphthalene both sublime, so sublimation cannot separate them; benzoic acid dissolves in hot water while naphthalene does not, so they are separated by crystallisation: (IV).

(C) Aniline is steam-volatile and immiscible with water, so it is separated from water by steam distillation: (I).

(D) Naphthalene sublimes on heating while sodium chloride does not, so they are separated by sublimation: (II).

Hence, the correct option is (D).

en.content:
Which statements are correct about degrees of freedom ?

(A) A molecule with n degrees of freedom has n different ways of storing energy.

(B) Each degree of freedom is associated with RT average energy per mole.

(C) A monatomic gas molecule has 1 rotational degree of freedom whereas diatomic molecule has 2 rotational degrees of freedom.

(D) has a total of 6 degrees of freedom.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: (B) and (C) only
(B) and (D) only
(A) and (B) only
(C) and (D) only

en.explanation: Statement A is incorrect, statement B is correct by equipartition of energy. Statement C is incorrect as monoatomic does not have any rotational degree of freedom and CH4 is a polyatomic gas so it has 6 degree of freedom. So only B and D are correct.

en.content:
With reference to the observations in photo-electric effect, identify the correct statements from below :

(A) The square of maximum velocity of photoelectrons varies linearly with frequency of incident light.

(B) The value of saturation current increases on moving the source of light away from the metal surface.

(C) The maximum kinetic energy of photo-electrons decreases on decreasing the power of LED (light emitting diode) source of light.

(D) The immediate emission of photo-electrons out of metal surface can not be explained by particle nature of light/electromagnetic waves.

(E) Existence of threshold wavelength can not be explained by wave nature of light/ electromagnetic waves.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: (A) and (B) only
(A) and (E) only
(C) and (E) only
(D) and (E) only

en.explanation:
Statement (A): from , , which is linear in . Correct.

Statement (B): moving the source away lowers the intensity at the surface, so fewer photoelectrons are emitted and the saturation current decreases. Incorrect.

Statement (C): the maximum kinetic energy depends only on the frequency of the light and the work function, not on the power of the source. Incorrect.

Statement (D): each photon gives its whole energy to one electron at once, so the particle nature of light explains immediate emission. Incorrect.

Statement (E): on the wave picture, light of any wavelength would eject electrons if intense enough, so a threshold wavelength cannot be explained; it needs the photon picture, . Correct.

Only statements (A) and (E) are correct.

Hence, the correct option is (B).
